post.title: Oil just had its biggest drop since April. Gas hasn't yet
post.ig:
Oil just fell 8.3% in a single day.
US crude closed Wednesday, Nov 4, near $88.12 a barrel, oil's biggest daily drop since April. Brent went from as high as $118 on Friday to about $94.
Traders cited hopes for an end to the Iran war after Tuesday's midterms.
Gas averaged $4.12 Wednesday morning, 39% above pre-war levels; GasBuddy's Patrick De Haan says it could dip below $4 in the days ahead. Diesel futures fell nearly 7%. Oil is still about 60% higher than at the start of the year.
Sources: NBC News, Rigzone (Nov 4, 2026).
